answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities and demands a heartbeat signal: 10 seconds of compute within 30 seconds. The heartbeat must clear a ridge of compute, so one machine cannot fake many at once. A faker running 100 identities sees most miss; each miss burns 5 POA. Forging 100 costs 500 POA per missed round; an honest agent pays 5 POA once and stays in the meadow.
